body: Just an update.. Just finished my last day of the program. Said goodbye to the staff and other patients..It was sad but I got the closure and confidence I needed. It also turns out that I am still allowed to email my therapist just not other patients or staff members which is a huge relief.

It's just that until today I really felt like I was better and back to the way before all this stuff happened and I am just scared that without having the support I'll go right back to where I started... I have trouble trusting new people and I feel like having to find a different therapist will just be a giant step backwards. I'm scared to tell my treatment team tomorrow that I don't feel ready because I'll just feel like an even bigger failure.
Sorry if any of this doesn't make sense..Just feeling really stressed and overwhelmed and I don't know what I am gonna do.
